name: Steady Hands
description: You do not shake when it matters. Binding a wound under pressure comes as easily as at rest.

name: Practised Liar
description: The lie arrives already worn in. You have told this one before, in other towns, under other names.

name: Hard to Read
description: Your face gives nothing. Those reading you get less than they think they do.

name: Quiet Footed
description: Floorboards forgive you. You have left rooms nobody knew you entered.

name: Night Eyes
description: You see in the dark better than you should, and have stopped mentioning it.

name: Strong Back
description: You carry what two others would split, and are asked to, constantly.

name: Iron Stomach
description: You have eaten worse than this and kept it down. Going without sits lighter on you than on other people.

name: Taken in Sips
description: You learned to make a canteen last on a road with no wells. The habit never left.

name: Quick Hands
description: You waste no motion at a bench. The work is no better than anyone else's, it is simply finished sooner.

name: Weather Eye
description: You know where a seam runs and where a thing grows before you have started digging for it.

name: Duellist
description: Trained for the single opponent who has agreed to it, a narrower education than it sounds, and a deadly one.

name: Field Surgeon
description: You have worked on people who were still being shot at. Speed, and a tolerance for screaming.

name: Grave-Touched
description: The dead find you legible. They answer a little more readily, and are no more honest for it.

name: The Old Tongue
description: You were taught the imperial speech by someone who remembered it being spoken in anger.

name: Porter
description: Somewhere along the way you stopped arguing about who carries the sacks, and now nobody else offers.

name: Sworn Witness
description: You have stood up in front of people who did not want to hear it and said what you saw. When you name a stranger to a room, the room believes you.

name: Taproom Lawyer
description: You can make a bad position sound procedural. Half of talking your way out of a room is sounding bored while you do it.

name: Master of the Bench
description: Your tools are where your hand goes. Others watch you work and cannot say what you did differently.

name: Read the Ground
description: Tracks, spoor, bent grass, the wrong kind of quiet. You take what a place has before it has noticed you are there.

name: Shield of the Line
description: You were taught to stand where someone else would have to fall first. It is a habit of position, not of courage.

name: Unremarkable
description: People give descriptions of you that could be anyone. You have worked at this for years.

name: The Full Kit
description: Needle, gut, tincture, tourniquet, and the discipline to have packed them before they were needed.

name: Lean Years
description: You have been hungrier than this for longer than this, and you were still walking at the end of it.

name: Deep Draught
description: You drink like someone who expects not to find water again, and then do not think about it.

name: A Second Vessel
description: Holding one up was the hard part. The second is only more of the same weight, which is not a comfort.

name: The Long Memory
description: Names, seals, debts, and who was standing where when the thing happened. You have never needed to write any of it down.

name: Past the Point
description: There is a moment where sensible people stop. You have been on the other side of it often enough that it no longer registers as a decision.

name: Second Blow
description: The follow-up stops being a decision and becomes a habit. Where another soldier commits to one stroke a round, you have already begun the next.
